stem: By the end of the selection, what can the reader conclude about LEGO products?

options.label: A
options.text: LEGO products are more popular with adults than with children.

options.label: B
options.text: LEGO products are not as popular outside the United States.

options.label: C
options.text: LEGO has designed its products to appeal to people of all ages.

options.label: D
options.text: LEGO has created theme parks and video games to replace its original products.
